_comment_global: IceCube DeepCore Le-Ltau / event-level HDF5 3.1. SAFE/RUNNABLE CONFIGURATION: 2 LRI parameters + 9 existing nuisance parameters FLOAT. ma_ccqe, ma_ccres, dis_csms are explicitly FIXED to nominal values. theta23 and dm31 are held at the nominal values implicit in the precomputed nuSQuIDS templates (dm31 read from the HDF5; theta23 not recorded there). The optional _future_floating_parameters block DOCUMENTS how to expand to 16 floating parameters; it is inert and must not be treated as an active fit.
_comment_lri_model: Model=Le-Ltau; kernel reads results/templates/Le-Ltau.h5 from LRI_REPOSITORY_ROOT. For Lmu-Ltau, log10_g represents log10|G_mutau| with the signed coupling branch in HDF5.
_comment_scan_settings: Currently floats only 11 variables, with 1D scans on all 11 and 2D scans on (log10_g, log10_m), profiling the other nine. Once physical responses are available, add new nuisance names to start_values and optionally target_subset_1d; the 2D target subset remains (log10_g,log10_m). num_cores can be overridden from the CLI.
_comment_repair: Retain raw likelihood profile surfaces. Point-level Minuit retries and simplex polishing remain available; no smoothing or repair of raw profiles.
_comment_steps: Numerical Minuit step sizes, not systematic uncertainty widths.
_comment_limits: Physical log10_g and log10_m bounds retain the OLD [-30,-24], [-15,-11] values and have not been checked against the true HDF5 3.1 axes. BEFORE a real fit, compare axes/log10_abs_coupling and axes/log10_mass_eV against parameter_limits and validate start_values. Other limits are from the prior config.
_comment_fixed: These three parameters are passed explicitly through kernel.PARAMETER_ORDER but are NOT free in Minuit. In the likelihood, exactly nominal axial masses and dis_csms=0 have unit event reweights. Keep axial_mass_reweight_convention=unconfirmed and dis_csms_response_file=null until physically validated. Do not invent the actual theta23 nominal angle: only dm31 nominal is recoverable from hypersurfaces.attrs[dm31_fixed_eV2] in the HDF5 3.1.
_comment_starts: Original 3.0 starting values; check physical log10_g and log10_m against new 3.1 HDF5 axes before starting minimization.
_comment_fallbacks: Only previous three Gaussian priors are ACTIVE: DOM 1.0+/-0.1, delta_gamma_nu 0.0+/-0.1, NC/CC 1.0+/-0.2. Do not add axial, DIS or oscillation priors before their physical definitions and corresponding external likelihood are validated.
_comment_confidence: Asymptotic Wilks thresholds from previous configuration; FC calibration deferred. The fixed-standard-oscillation, fixed-axial, fixed-CSMS fit is not equivalent to profiling all 16 parameters and its coverage has not been calibrated.
_comment_output_dir: New output directory: do not reuse old 11-parameter checkpoint files, because the new kernel vector now also contains three fixed cross-section parameters.
_comment_response_settings: SAFE defaults: axial linear/quadratic coefficients need a verified polynomial coordinate; GENIE->CSMS needs an event-matched NPZ of total+differential factors; theta23/dm31 require validated nuSQuIDS weight responses. The kernel intentionally errors before Minuit if a response is missing.

_future_floating_parameters._note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY. This block is ignored by GenericLikelihoodWrapper and by the kernel. To float a parameter, REMOVE it from fixed_params (if present) and ADD it to start_values, step_sizes, parameter_limits and, only once justified, fallbacks/input_configs. For theta23/dm31 provide a real oscillation_weight_provider.

ma_ccqe.prior_note: Asymmetric uncertainty -15%/+25%; GenericLikelihoodWrapper needs an asymmetric prior implementation or validated external prior. Do not approximate silently with a Gaussian.

ma_ccres.prior_note: If using a 20% Gaussian uncertainty, justify it against the adopted public analysis and use sigma=0.224 GeV.

dis_csms.prior_note: No prior has been imposed; verify parameter meaning/uncertainty from the corresponding IceCube release.

theta23.prior_note: Do not invent an external theta23 prior; preserve correlations with dm31 if using external oscillation constraints.

dm31.prior_note: Read actual HDF5 nominal first; do not assume main.cpp default of 2.47e-3 equals the 2.513e-3 in hypersurface metadata.
